design.instruct: A cheerful, kind Indian man in his thirties, a favourite storyteller for young children, speaking English with a light Indian accent, warm, playful and clear, relaxed pace.
design.note: Designing again gives a SIMILAR voice; clone reference.wav for the exact one.

reproduce.ref_text: It was the hottest day of the whole summer. The sun was shining, the roads were sizzling, and everyone in the colony was thirsty. That is when Rio had a big idea.
